name: Gym & fitness classes

google_prefill.phone: [G] the listed phone (stays the business's; customers use Rosie's one number)

A.flow: A: the customer comes to the business (video or phone count as A)
A.staff: Bri and Jamal (coaches) and the front desk
A.customer: Alex M. (a first-timer) · other members and guests

services.name: Day pass with a class
services.story: The main story: a $55 day pass for Sat Oct 24 with a seat in Bri's 11:00am indoor cycling class (20 bikes), paid in full when booking. Packs, the intro offer and a membership are paid when bought. Alex is new, so the waiver and health questions are done on the secure page.

services.name: Drop-in class
services.story: A $35 drop-in class. A card is saved for the gym's $20 late-cancel or no-show fee, and Alex pays at the front desk.

B.flow: B: the business goes to the customer
B.staff: Kofi and Nadia (coaches who go out)
B.customer: Alex M. (books for the office) · coworkers

services.name: Office bootcamp
services.story: The main story: a $179 office bootcamp for up to 12 coworkers at Alex's office with Kofi. A card is saved for the $89 late-cancel fee, and it's charged $179 when Kofi texts DONE.

services.name: Office bootcamp
services.story: The same $179 office bootcamp for a company that pays by bill: nothing is taken to book, and Rosie texts the bill after.

services.name: Office strength class
services.story: A $150 office strength class for up to 12 people, paid in full when booking.

services_shape: class: a seat (a bike, a bag, a spot) in a set class time with a set number of places and a waitlist; each person booked is checked in on their own. A day pass is the gym floor for the day, with no cap. Away from the gym, a coach leads one group at the customer's office, park or building, booked whole by the host
questions_before_times: new to the gym, or been before (sets the intro offer, the waiver and the health questions)
the class, or a day pass, and which day
a pack or a membership to use, if they have one
for a teen class: the teen's age
away from the gym: an office, a park or a building, and how many people
safety_stop: someone unwell right now: chest pain, fainting, trouble breathing, a bad fall
license: from the state form: coaching group fitness classes usually needs no state license; some states register health clubs or gyms that sell memberships, and may ask for a bond for months paid ahead; massage needs a license where the state's rules require it
staff_skills: indoor cycling, HIIT, boxing, strength, teen classes, chair fitness; only coaches cleared for teen classes coach them
messages_never: health answers, injuries, pregnancy and incident notes never go in a text or through the AI, and texts to the owner or staff carry none either: only a link to the secure page
demo_note: Demo data for testing only. [G] = prefilled from the business's Google listing at sign-up; the owner checks each field.
